# reads

:::info[Typed specification]

Generated by the pinned `ess generate --kind docs` from [`adapters/prometheus/spec/ess`](https://github.com/beyond10x/connectors/tree/main/adapters/prometheus/spec/ess). Structural validation establishes consistency; behaviour, storage and cross-record predicates remain implementation obligations.

Prometheus-owned PromQL instant and range selections, their result kinds and series bounds.

`connectors_prometheus.reads` is one of connectors_prometheus's bounded contexts. [Back to the index](../index.md).

## Types

### `InstantSelection`

`connectors_prometheus.reads.InstantSelection` is a record of four fields:

- `query` — `String`
- `time_unix_s` — `Optional<Integer>`, which may be absent
- `max_series` — `Optional<Integer>`, which may be absent
- `max_samples_per_series` — `Optional<Integer>`, which may be absent

Every value satisfies `(query.count >= 1 and query.count <= 16384)`, `(time_unix_s >= 0 and time_unix_s <= 9999999999)`, `(max_series >= 1 and max_series <= 500)` and `(max_samples_per_series >= 1 and max_samples_per_series <= 2000)`.

### `RangeSelection`

`connectors_prometheus.reads.RangeSelection` is a record of six fields:

- `query` — `String`
- `start_unix_s` — `Integer`
- `end_unix_s` — `Integer`
- `step_s` — `Integer`
- `max_series` — `Optional<Integer>`, which may be absent
- `max_samples_per_series` — `Optional<Integer>`, which may be absent

Every value satisfies `(query.count >= 1 and query.count <= 16384)`, `(start_unix_s >= 0 and start_unix_s <= 9999999999)`, `(end_unix_s >= 0 and end_unix_s <= 9999999999)`, `(step_s >= 1 and step_s <= 604800)`, `(max_series >= 1 and max_series <= 500)` and `(max_samples_per_series >= 1 and max_samples_per_series <= 2000)`.

### `ResultType`

`connectors_prometheus.reads.ResultType` is one of `vector`, `matrix`, `scalar` and `string`.

### `Window`

`connectors_prometheus.reads.Window` is a record of three fields:

- `start_unix_s` — `Integer`
- `end_unix_s` — `Integer`
- `step_s` — `Integer`

Four of the types above are reached by nothing else in this system: `connectors_prometheus.reads.InstantSelection`, `connectors_prometheus.reads.RangeSelection`, `connectors_prometheus.reads.ResultType` and `connectors_prometheus.reads.Window`. No entity, view, command, event, error or crossing names them, so it is either vocabulary something outside this specification uses or a leftover — and only a person can tell which.
